title: Identification of Glycolysis-Related Genes in MAFLD and Their Immune Infiltration Implications: A Multi-Omics Analysis with Experimental Validation.
authors: Chen, Jiawei; Yang, Siqi; Shou, Diwen; Liu, Bo; Li, Shaohan; Luo, Tongtong; Chen, Huiting; Huang, Chen; Zhou, Yongjian
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过多组学与机器学习识别MAFLD糖酵解关键基因并分析免疫浸润，虽涉及转录因子YY1/FOXC1匹配，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，方法为表达分析与湿实验验证，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Background: Metabolic-associated fatty liver disease (MAFLD) is characterized by metabolic syndrome and immune infiltration, with glycolysis pathway activation emerging as a pivotal contributor. This study aims to identify glycolysis-associated key genes driving MAFLD progression and elucidate their crosstalk with immune infiltration through bioinformatics analysis and experimental validation. Methods: Integrative multi-omics analysis was performed on bulk RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, and spatial transcriptomic datasets from MAFLD patients and controls. Differential expression analysis and WGCNA were employed to pinpoint glycolysis-correlated key genes. The relationship with immune infiltration was analyzed using single-cell and spatial transcriptomics technologies. Machine learning was applied to identify feature genes for matching shared TFs and miRNAs. External cohort validation and in vivo experiments (methionine choline-deficient diet murine models) were conducted for biological confirmation. Results: Five glycolysis-associated key genes (ALDH3A1, CDK1, DEPDC1, HKDC1, SOX9) were identified and validated as MAFLD discriminators. Single-cell analysis revealed that the hepatocyte-fibroblast-macrophage axis constitutes the predominant glycolysis-active niche. Spatial transcriptomics showed that CDK1, SOX9, and HKDC1 were colocalized with the monocyte-derived macrophage marker CCR2. Using four machine learning models, four feature genes were identified, along with their common transcription factors YY1 and FOXC1, and the miRNA "hsa-miR-590-3p". External datasets and experimental validation confirmed that the key genes were upregulated in MAFLD samples. Conclusions: In this study, we identified five glycolysis-related key genes in MAFLD and explored their relationship with immune infiltration, providing new insights for diagnosis and metabolism-directed immunomodulation strategies in MAFLD.
abstract_zh: 背景：代谢相关脂肪性肝病（MAFLD）以代谢综合征和免疫浸润为特征，其中糖酵解途径的激活已成为关键促进因素。本研究旨在通过生物信息学分析和实验验证，识别驱动MAFLD进展的糖酵解相关关键基因，并阐明其与免疫浸润之间的相互作用。方法：对MAFLD患者和对照组的批量RNA测序、单细胞RNA测序及空间转录组数据集进行了整合多组学分析。采用差异表达分析和加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）来锁定与糖酵解相关的关键基因。利用单细胞和空间转录组技术分析其与免疫浸润的关系。应用机器学习识别特征基因，以匹配共享的转录因子和miRNA。通过外部队列验证和体内实验（蛋氨酸胆碱缺乏饮食小鼠模型）进行生物学确认。结果：鉴定并验证了五个糖酵解相关关键基因（ALDH3A1、CDK1、DEPDC1、HKDC1、SOX9）作为MAFLD的判别因子。单细胞分析揭示，肝细胞-成纤维细胞-巨噬细胞轴构成了主要的糖酵解活跃生态位。空间转录组学显示，CDK1、SOX9和HKDC1与单核细胞来源的巨噬细胞标志物CCR2共定位。利用四种机器学习模型，识别出四个特征基因及其共同转录因子YY1和FOXC1，以及miRNA“hsa-miR-590-3p”。外部数据集和实验验证确认，这些关键基因在MAFLD样本中表达上调。结论：在本研究中，我们识别了MAFLD中五个与糖酵解相关的关键基因，并探讨了它们与免疫浸润的关系，为MAFLD的诊断和代谢导向的免疫调节策略提供了新见解。
